Focus.dc.html.title: 3 · Focus — the HUD at a part

Hud.dc.html.title: 10 · Option B — Home in the Command HUD skin

t1.text: The One Place · world — the post-login home. Press Play on any screen and click through.

n1.text:
BUILD NOTE 1 · HOME (SURFACE shell desk)
Route: GET /command stays the entry; this screen replaces its TODAY tab as the default and becomes the signed-in landing for every account (owner spec: the home page when you log in). Layout: one CSS grid, rows 52 | 36 | 1fr | 56 | 30, columns 220 | 1fr | 300. Left column = Character (account + brain, from whoami + corpus_stats) · Command menu (one <nav>, items are the existing tab links plus Quests/Party/Inventory/Time) · Party (arms from arms.keys(), never a typed list; the mock types six ratified names). Centre = the world: templates/goal_atlas.html data (static/atlas/topology.json): polar layout, angle = node.a, radius by layer (world 272, arms 240, sensors 212, doors 178, stores 142, meaning 108, faculties 72, core 0), the rim is a heptagon whose vertices are regionDividers. Machine (infra) is the strip under the map; Surfaces are the windows row; Novah is the character. Right column = Today (needs_you + goal_tree.rollup + ME ladders, same JSON as the iPhone Command tab) · Act (PendingAction queue, ages) · minimap. Bottom = Ask box (one ask path, ONE-PLACE-ASK) · key legend. Keys are a shell-level keydown map (H B M / T A ? Q 1-9 arrows Enter Esc); this mock only shows them. User mode reads through the allow-list readers (#713); the customer sees their own parts lit and unconnected sensors dim as idle (a move: connect). Resource bar reads current_finances, current_spend, corpus_stats, whats_on_today. Every number in the mock is an example.

n2.text:
BUILD NOTE 2 · MAP AND OVERLAYS (SURFACE shell desk)
No route change: /command#map opens the world with the overlay menu; the old /goal/atlas 302s here. The overlay menu lists the 55 picks of Atlas Live v11 (18 layers, 37 views) in two columns; a layer tints the places it owns and dims the rest, a view re-draws the same model (counts, flows, states) and never leaves the page. Keys 1-9 toggle the first nine overlays; M opens and closes the menu; Esc closes it. Active overlays show as chips on the stage so the viewer always knows what tints the map. State rule unchanged: ready has no hue, stale amber, broken rose, unknown hollow/dashed, idle dim, indigo only for the selected place. Data: topology.json nodes + the live per-line counts from #736; layers.key maps to the atlas layer keys (infra, world, sensor, store, brain, faculty, meaning, door, arm, surface, owner) and the view list is the picks file the atlas page already carries. Reduced motion: no dolly, a cut. The three.js crystal in goal_atlas.html can stay as a view (Crystal 3D) behind the same menu; the default is this 2D ring, server-rendered so the page works without script.

n3.text:
BUILD NOTE 3 · FOCUS, THE HUD AT A PART (SURFACE shell desk)
URL: /command#map?focus=<node id> (and ?focus= on the stable page). The stage becomes the wall's focus renderer (templates/admin_wall.html, #654/#715: focus drawn large in its own form, tiles for what it opens into, dashed tiles for what is connected by an edge, trail to the root, findings and moves) laid out as the HUD: STATE card · FINDINGS with the fix (each finding carries its repair as a move with its disposition shown before any click: safe runs, fix runs and logs, outward is queued for you) · MOVES · AHEAD (neighbours from node.out, verb from edgeKinds) · BEHIND (the trail, also the Back key). The minimap keeps the world and marks where you stand. Today and Act stay in the right rail; Ask stays docked. Arrow keys move the cursor between neighbours, Enter enters, B/Backspace goes back one step, H goes home. Every coloured mark keeps its word (chip tests from 1/1 still apply). Unknown is hollow, never zero. Nothing acts from the HUD except through Act: a move with an outward disposition opens the door with the proposal already written.

n4.text:
BUILD NOTE 4 · ACT, THE DOOR (SURFACE shell desk + DOORS for the queue)
Not a page: A or the Act rail opens the door as a panel over the dimmed world (Esc closes, the world stays where it was). Reads PendingAction with created / decided / executed and egress_log by door and outcome (same as /command#act today). Oldest first; over seven days reads rose with the word old. Approve, Reject and Ask me later are the only controls and call the queue, never the capability (Law 9). The selected proposal shows what it would do, through which door and arm, and the disposition it gets. The audit below lists what left today, what was refused and why, and an unverified meter as hollow. Owner mode shows the estate queue; user mode the person's own. The Act rail chip in the HUD carries the count and the oldest age everywhere.

n5.text:
BUILD NOTE 5 · ASK, OVER THE MAP (SURFACE shell + INTELLIGENCE ONE-PLACE-ASK)
The docked box is the only Ask; pressing Enter or ? opens the transcript as a panel over the world and the places the answer read light up on the map (cites map to node ids: mail -> s-mail, calendar -> s-calendar, goal -> m-plan, need -> f-needs). Every answer lists the rows it read as chips; an answer that cannot cite does not ship, it says so in amber and offers the nearest cited fact. A cited row is a link: clicking it focuses that place (screen 3). The mic reads local only and stays grey until the home node voice path exists (NODE VOICE-IN-THE-SHELL); never a browser speech API (Law 9). Developer register adds row ids and retrieval k. Metered as its own feature. One ask path shared with the iPhone Ask tab.

n6.text:
BUILD NOTE 6 · JUMP, SEARCH TO ANYWHERE (SURFACE shell desk)
/ or the top-bar box opens the palette; it searches one index built in-process from: places (topology nodes, with state), overlays (the 55 picks), quests (goals and campaigns), people (relationship graph, user mode only through the allow-list), and commands (the menu). Results grouped, best first, state chip on every place, keyboard only: up/down, Enter jumps (focus for a place, overlay on for a pick, quest log for a quest, Act for a proposal), Esc closes. Jumping pushes the trail so Back returns. No network per keystroke: the index ships with the page snapshot (60 s) and SHELL-JSON-SESSION-READ (DOORS) serves refreshes session-authed off /api.

n7.text:
BUILD NOTE 7 · QUESTS (SURFACE shell desk)
Q or the menu opens the quest log over the world: goals (goal_tree, outcomes.latest, the GoalPlan next step) and campaigns (campaign_status) in one list, worst first, each with its outcome state, the last move, the next step and its disposition, and the places it touches (lit on the map behind). Selecting a quest marks its places on the minimap. Start a step calls the plan (pursue_goal / schedule_campaign); anything outward lands in Act, never runs from here. A goal with no outcome reads unknown with a hollow dot, never fine. Time (the day, the morning book, the schedule) is the sibling panel on the same key row (whats_on_today).

n8.text:
BUILD NOTE 8 · OWNER, THE WHOLE ESTATE (SURFACE shell desk)
Same page, same grid, same keys. ?mode=admin only for a bare admin session (ATLAS-ACT Q4=A: the estate plus the owner's own needs, never another person's data). What changes: the scope pill turns amber and reads whole estate (Mine / Estate toggle beside it); the world lights all 90 places with the estate census (observability_wall.compose, 60 s snapshot) and the parts count from static/atlas/parts.hub.json; Today gains the estate pane (census bar with unknown hatched, worst three boards); Act shows the estate queue; the command menu gains the owner powers under a divider: Estate, Desks (the sessions roster), Train (ci-novahub hold), Spend (spend gate and meters), Runners (the eleven CI containers). The owner is also the character: the Novah layer. Nothing here is a new door: every power reads a board that exists and acts only through Act.

n9.text:
BUILD NOTE 9 · PHONE (SURFACE shell desk; INTELLIGENCE CC-PHONE-READY; the iPhone app, GOAL-iphone-command-center)
The same page under 760 px, and what the iPhone app renders from the same JSON. The world fills the width; Today and Act are a bottom sheet (drag up, 55 % max); Ask docks above the tab bar; the tab bar is Home · Map · Quests · Act · Ask with counts; the command menu is the More sheet; keys become gestures (tap a place to enter it, swipe back, long-press for the overlay menu). Hit targets 44 px. The minimap becomes the location chip in the top bar. No fake status bar: the real one renders on top.

n10.text:
OPTION B · THE SAME HOME IN THE LEADFUEL COMMAND HUD SKIN (a choice for the owner, not a build note)
Screens 1-9 use the Novah tokens skin the owner gated for this task (q176 C2=B) and that hub #772 merged: neutral ink, indigo only for the selected thing, colour only where something is wrong, system font, no external asset (the hub serves script-src self and holds no font files). The CC-GAME-SHELL text, relayed by ROUTER #24, says the one interface should look like the LeadFuel Command design: cyan HUD, hexagon pips, corner brackets, Barlow Condensed display over Barlow body with JetBrains Mono labels. Those are two visual languages and the owner asked for one. This screen is the same Home drawn in the Command skin so the choice can be made by looking. If B is chosen: the tokens change is real (a third skin file or a re-skin of tokens-novah.css: cyan accent, the pip states, the bracket panel), the three Google font families need either a CSP font-src and a fonts stylesheet or self-hosted woff2 under static/, and the atlas page keeps its own look until it adopts the new tokens. If A is chosen: nothing changes; screens 1-9 are the design.
